title: "Power-conference players are drafted at five times the Group of 5 rate, and Alabama leads four positions"
date: "2026-10-31"
description: "Players who finished their college careers at Power-conference schools from 2013 to 2025 were drafted at five times the Group of 5 rate, 13.8% against 2.7%, and the gap held at every position."
followups:
  - "Do teams that win more produce more draftees, once position mix is accounted for? (Post 3)"
  - "Is the falling Group of 5 draft rate a transfer effect? Credit draftees to every school they played for, weighted by seasons or snaps."
  - "Does a school's position mix reflect recruiting or development? Compare draftees above expected with recruiting ratings at entry."
  - "Recover undrafted offensive linemen from NFL rosters by name and school, without a stat line."
  - "Fill FCS-and-below rosters so that tier can be ranked school by school."
author:
  - "AI directed by Nick Giangreco"
freeze: auto
vignette: >
  %\VignetteIndexEntry{Power-conference players are drafted at five times the Group of 5 rate, and Alabama leads four positions}
  %\VignetteEngine{quarto::html}

```{.r .cell-code}
# ---- Packages, data connection and figure defaults -------------------------
# Load the project's functions straight from the checkout with pkgload; the
# repo is never installed (decision 0042). The site build sets CFB2NFL_ROOT,
# a local render finds the checkout from the working directory.
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
library(DBI)
library(dplyr)
library(duckdb)
library(ggiraph)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)

# One interaction style for every girafe figure: a clear hover pop, dimming
# of non-hovered marks, a dark tooltip, and toolbar zoom + PNG download.
set_girafe_defaults(
  opts_hover = opts_hover(
    css = "stroke:#111827;stroke-width:2.5px;filter:brightness(1.12);"
  ),
  opts_hover_inv = opts_hover_inv(css = "opacity:0.45;"),
  opts_tooltip = opts_tooltip(
    css = "background:#111827;color:#fff;padding:6px 9px;border-radius:5px;font-weight:bold;font-size:15px;"
  ),
  opts_zoom = opts_zoom(min = 1, max = 5),
  opts_toolbar = opts_toolbar(saveaspng = TRUE, position = "topright"),
  opts_sizing = opts_sizing(rescale = TRUE)
)

# thousands-separated and percent formatters for inline numbers
fmt <- function(x, digits = 0) {
  formatC(as.numeric(x), big.mark = ",", format = "f", digits = digits)
}
pct <- function(x, digits = 1) sprintf("%.*f%%", digits, 100 * x)

# ---- Named players (keyed on athlete id) -----------------------------------
# Key on athlete id, never name: picks has two Josh Allens (Wyoming 2018,
# Kentucky 2019).
subjects <- tibble::tribble(
  ~who         , ~cfb_athlete_id ,
  "Joe Burrow" , "3915511"       ,
  "Cam Ward"   , "4688380"       ,
  "Josh Allen" , "3918298"       ,
  "Jordan Travis" , "4360799"
)

# ---- Load the tables -------------------------------------------------------
team_season <- dbReadTable(con, "team_season")
team_draft <- dbReadTable(con, "team_draft")
teams <- dbReadTable(con, "teams")
roster <- dbReadTable(con, "roster")
picks <- dbReadTable(con, "picks")

tier_order <- c("Power", "Group of 5", "FCS and below")
tier_colors <- c(
  "Power" = "#1d4ed8",
  "Group of 5" = "#f59e0b",
  "FCS and below" = "#6b7280"
)
team_colors <- team_color_values(teams)
# Notre Dame is Power (decision 0003) though it plays as an FBS independent.

# Final college seasons 2013 to 2025, approximately the draft classes of
# 2014 to 2026; the 2026 season is in progress.
first_season <- 2013L
last_season <- 2025L
credited <- team_draft |>
  filter(season >= first_season, season <= last_season) |>
  mutate(tier_label = factor(tier_label, levels = tier_order))
fbs_cr <- credited |>
  filter(tier_label != "FCS and below") |>
  mutate(
    # Notre Dame as an independent is a one-school Power group (it played
    # 2020 in the ACC); the other independents are Group of 5
    league = case_when(
      conference == "FBS Independents" & team == "Notre Dame" ~ "Notre Dame",
      conference == "FBS Independents" ~ "Other FBS independents",
      .default = conference
    )
  )

# Each school's 2025 conference for within-conference comparisons; Idaho
# left FBS after 2017, so it keeps its last FBS conference.
conf_now <- team_season |>
  filter(classification == "fbs", season <= last_season) |>
  group_by(team) |>
  slice_max(season, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup() |>
  transmute(
    team,
    # the 2025 independents (Notre Dame, UConn) form one group
    conf_now = if_else(conference == "FBS Independents", "FBS independents", conference),
    conf_now_tier = tier_label,
    conf_now_season = season
  )
fbs_schools <- distinct(fbs_cr, team) |> left_join(conf_now, by = "team")
left_fbs <- filter(fbs_schools, conf_now_season < last_season)

# The recurring cast, by id, credited to the last roster school before
# the draft.
star <- function(who) {
  id <- subjects$cfb_athlete_id[subjects$who == who]
  pk <- filter(picks, playerId == id)
  last_stop <- roster |>
    filter(playerId == id, season < pk$year) |>
    slice_max(season, n = 1)
  first_stop <- roster |>
    filter(playerId == id) |>
    slice_min(season, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
  mutate(pk, last_team = last_stop$team, first_team = first_stop$team)
}
burrow <- star("Joe Burrow")
ward <- star("Cam Ward")
allen <- star("Josh Allen")
travis <- star("Jordan Travis")
ward_teams <- unique(roster$team[roster$playerId == ward$playerId])
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
*Data as of the latest published release, retrieved 2026-10-31. Players
are counted in their final college season, 2013 through 2025, which covers
approximately the draft classes of 2014 through 2026.*
:::

## 1. Introduction

The [previous post](2026-10-31-conferences-landscape.html) found half of
all draft picks coming from a short list of schools; this one asks how
often players who finish their careers at a conference, school, or position
get drafted, counting each draftee for the last school they played for (Joe
Burrow for LSU, not Ohio State; Cam Ward for Miami, not Washington State;
Jordan Travis for Florida State; Josh Allen for Wyoming). It also checks
the nicknames fans give schools: is LSU still DBU, Penn State still
Linebacker U, USC still Tailback U, BYU still QBU, and Iowa still Tight End
U?

## 2. Data

### 2.1 An eligible player is one whose college career ended with a real shot at the draft


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
n_eligible <- sum(credited$n_eligible)
n_exits <- sum(credited$n_exits)
n_drafted <- sum(credited$n_drafted)
n_udfa <- sum(credited$n_udfa)
```
:::


Every rate in the post divides by eligible players, so the table defines
them and every other term; of the 87,903 players whose college
careers ended from 2013 to 2025, 44,243 were eligible,
3,129 were drafted, and 3,374 signed undrafted.

## 3. Results


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
rates <- function(d) {
  d |>
    summarise(
      schools = n_distinct(team),
      eligible = sum(n_eligible),
      drafted = sum(n_drafted),
      udfa = sum(n_udfa),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    mutate(draft_rate = drafted / eligible, udfa_rate = udfa / eligible)
}
tier_rates <- rates(group_by(credited, tier_label))
tr <- function(t, col) tier_rates[[col]][tier_rates$tier_label == t]
power_g5 <- tr("Power", "draft_rate") / tr("Group of 5", "draft_rate")
# a conference's tier is the one most of its eligible players played in
# (the Pac-12's two 2024 and 2025 schools are Group of 5)
league_tier <- fbs_cr |>
  count(league, tier_label, wt = n_eligible) |>
  group_by(league) |>
  slice_max(n, n = 1) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(league, tier = tier_label)
conf_rates <- rates(group_by(fbs_cr, league)) |>
  left_join(league_tier, by = "league") |>
  arrange(desc(draft_rate))
cr_rate <- function(l, col = "draft_rate") {
  conf_rates[[col]][conf_rates$league == l]
}
season_rates <- rates(group_by(fbs_cr, season, tier_label))
g5_season <- filter(season_rates, tier_label == "Group of 5")
power_season <- filter(season_rates, tier_label == "Power")
g5_first <- g5_season$draft_rate[g5_season$season == first_season]
g5_last <- g5_season$draft_rate[g5_season$season == last_season]
```
:::


### 3.1 Power-conference players were drafted at five times the Group of 5 rate, 13.8% against 2.7%

The table counts eligible players and draftees by tier and conference, the
bars rank the conferences, and the season lines show the Group of 5 rate
falling from 4.1% of 2013 final seasons to 0.9% of
2025 final seasons while the Power rate stayed between
11.9% and 19.1%.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
bind_rows(
  tier_rates |>
    transmute(Group = paste("All", tier_label), Tier = as.character(tier_label), schools, eligible, drafted, draft_rate),
  conf_rates |>
    transmute(Group = league, Tier = as.character(tier), schools, eligible, drafted, draft_rate)
) |>
  transmute(
    Group,
    Tier,
    Schools = fmt(schools),
    `Eligible players` = fmt(eligible),
    Drafted = fmt(drafted),
    `Draft rate` = pct(draft_rate)
  ) |>
  kable(
    caption = "Eligible players and draftees by tier, then by FBS conference, for final seasons 2013 to 2025. A school counts in every conference it played in. The Pac-12 combines its Power seasons through 2023 with the two schools that remained in 2024 and 2025."
  )
```

```{.r .cell-code}
power_line <- tr("Power", "draft_rate")

p <- ggplot(
  conf_rates,
  aes(draft_rate, reorder(league, draft_rate), fill = tier)
) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(
      tooltip = paste0(
        league,
        " (",
        tier,
        "): ",
        fmt(drafted),
        " drafted of ",
        fmt(eligible),
        " eligible (",
        pct(draft_rate),
        ")"
      ),
      data_id = league
    ),
    width = 0.75
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = pct(draft_rate)),
    hjust = -0.15,
    size = 5,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = c(power_line, g5_line),
    color = tier_colors[c("Power", "Group of 5")],
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.9
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = c(power_line, g5_line) + 0.002,
    y = nrow(conf_rates) + 1,
    label = c(
      paste0("All Power: ", pct(power_line), ", five times the Group of 5"),
      paste0("All Group of 5: ", pct(g5_line))
    ),
    hjust = 0,
    size = 5,
    fontface = "bold",
    color = c(tier_colors[["Power"]], "#b45309")
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = expansion(add = c(0.6, 1.5))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = tier_colors, name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 0.25)) +
  labs(
    x = "Draft rate (drafted / eligible players)",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Every Power conference drafts above every Group of 5 conference",
    subtitle = "Final seasons 2013 to 2025; dashed lines are the tier totals"
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl()
```

```{.r .cell-code}
league_season <- rates(group_by(fbs_cr, league, season)) |>
  left_join(league_tier, by = "league")
p <- ggplot(
  league_season,
  aes(season, draft_rate, color = tier, group = league)
) +
  geom_line_interactive(
    aes(data_id = league, tooltip = league),
    linewidth = 1.1,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(
      data_id = league,
      tooltip = paste0(
        league,
        ", ",
        season,
        ": ",
        drafted,
        " drafted of ",
        eligible,
        " eligible (",
        pct(draft_rate),
        ")"
      )
    ),
    size = 2.6
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = tier_colors, name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(first_season, last_season, 2)) +
  labs(
    x = "Final college season",
    y = "Draft rate",
    title = "Every conference's draft rate, season by season",
    subtitle = "Hover a line to follow one conference; hover a point for its counts"
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl()
girafe(ggobj = p, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 7)
```

### 3.2 Undrafted signings are spread far more evenly, with Power players signing at under twice the Group of 5 rate

Power schools had 51% of FBS eligible players
and 84% of FBS draftees but only
66% of FBS undrafted free agents, as the table and
paired dots show conference by conference. In the scatter of every FBS
school, 26 of the 65 Power schools, led
by Rutgers, Vanderbilt and
Colorado, sent more players to the NFL undrafted than
drafted, and only 14 of the 25 schools with the most undrafted
signings are among the 25 with the most draftees.

```{.r .cell-code}
dumb <- conf_rates |>
  mutate(league = reorder(league, draft_rate)) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    c(draft_rate, udfa_rate),
    names_to = "outcome",
    values_to = "rate"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    outcome = if_else(outcome == "draft_rate", "Drafted", "Undrafted free agent"),
    n = if_else(outcome == "Drafted", drafted, udfa)
  )
outcome_colors <- c("Drafted" = "#1d4ed8", "Undrafted free agent" = "#0f766e")
n_g5_rows <- sum(conf_rates$tier == "Group of 5")
p <- ggplot(dumb, aes(rate, league)) +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = -Inf,
    xmax = Inf,
    ymin = 0.5,
    ymax = n_g5_rows + 0.5,
    fill = "#fef3c7",
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_line(aes(group = league), color = "#9ca3af", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(
      color = outcome,
      tooltip = paste0(
        league,
        ": ",
        fmt(n),
        " ",
        tolower(outcome),
        if_else(outcome == "Drafted", "", "s"),
        " of ",
        fmt(eligible),
        " eligible (",
        pct(rate),
        ")"
      ),
      data_id = paste(league, outcome)
    ),
    size = 5
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 0.19,
    y = n_g5_rows / 2 + 0.5,
    label = "Group of 5: more players\nsigned undrafted than were drafted",
    hjust = 1,
    size = 5,
    fontface = "bold",
    color = "#b45309"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = outcome_colors, name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 0.22)) +
  labs(
    x = "Share of eligible players",
    y = NULL,
    title = "The undrafted rate varies far less than the draft rate",
    subtitle = "Final seasons 2013 to 2025; hover a dot for counts"
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl()
girafe(ggobj = p, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 7)
```

```{.r .cell-code}
heavy_lab <- slice_head(udfa_heavy, n = 3) |>
  mutate(
    lx = draft_rate + c(-0.035, -0.04, 0.01),
    ly = udfa_rate + c(0.012, -0.012, 0.022)
  )
p <- ggplot(school_rates, aes(draft_rate, udfa_rate)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "#6b7280") +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 0.005,
    y = 0.168,
    label = "Above the line: more undrafted than drafted",
    hjust = 0,
    size = 4.6,
    color = "#374151"
  ) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(
      fill = team,
      size = eligible,
      tooltip = paste0(
        team,
        " (2025: ",
        conf_now,
        ")\n",
        drafted,
        " drafted, ",
        udfa,
        " undrafted free agents, of ",
        eligible,
        " eligible"
      ),
      data_id = team
    ),
    shape = 21,
    color = "white",
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = heavy_lab,
    aes(xend = lx, yend = ly, color = team),
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_label(
    data = heavy_lab,
    aes(lx, ly, label = team, color = team),
    size = 4.8,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = team_colors, guide = "none") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = team_colors, na.value = "#6b7280", guide = "none") +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 7, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 0.42), ylim = c(0, 0.17)) +
  labs(
    x = "Draft rate",
    y = "Undrafted rate",
    title = "Every FBS school's draft and undrafted rates",
    subtitle = "Team colors; dot size is eligible players; hover a dot for counts"
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl()
girafe(ggobj = p, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 9)
```

```{.r .cell-code}
pos_levels <- position_group_levels()
fbs_pos <- fbs_cr |>
  filter(position_group != "Position not recorded") |>
  mutate(position_group = factor(position_group, levels = pos_levels))
n_not_recorded <- sum(
  fbs_cr$n_eligible[fbs_cr$position_group == "Position not recorded"]
)
pos_tier <- rates(group_by(fbs_pos, position_group, tier_label)) |>
  select(position_group, tier_label, eligible, drafted, draft_rate) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = tier_label,
    values_from = c(eligible, drafted, draft_rate)
  ) |>
  mutate(ratio = draft_rate_Power / `draft_rate_Group of 5`)
# Notre Dame, a conference of one, is left to the school rankings
conf_pos <- rates(
  group_by(filter(fbs_pos, league != "Notre Dame"), league, position_group)
) |>
  group_by(position_group) |>
  mutate(leader = draft_rate == max(draft_rate)) |>
  ungroup()
pos_leaders <- filter(conf_pos, leader)
pos_tier <- left_join(
  pos_tier,
  select(pos_leaders, position_group, top = league, top_rate = draft_rate),
  by = "position_group"
)
n_sec_leads <- sum(pos_leaders$league == "SEC")
non_sec <- filter(pos_leaders, league != "SEC")
```

### 3.3 At every position Power players were drafted at four to six times the Group of 5 rate, and the SEC led eight of nine positions

The table compares Power and Group of 5 draft rates position by position,
the heatmap outlines each position's top conference, and the season panels
follow both tiers at every position. Notre Dame, a conference of one, is
left to the school rankings, and the 466 FBS eligible
players with no recorded position are left out from here on.

```{.r .cell-code}
  transmute(

    `Power eligible` = fmt(eligible_Power),
    `Power draft rate` = pct(draft_rate_Power),
    `Group of 5 eligible` = fmt(`eligible_Group of 5`),
    `Group of 5 draft rate` = pct(`draft_rate_Group of 5`),
    `Power rate ÷ Group of 5 rate` = sprintf("%.1f", ratio),
    `Top conference` = paste0(top, " (", pct(top_rate), ")")
  ) |>
  kable(

  )
```

```{.r .cell-code}
        tolower(position_group),

        " drafted of ",
        fmt(eligible),
        " eligible (",

        ")"
      ),
      data_id = paste(league, position_group)
    ),
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_tile(
    data = filter(heat, leader),
    fill = NA,
    color = "#111827",
    linewidth = 1.6
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = pct(draft_rate, 0),
      color = draft_rate > 0.12
    ),
    size = 4.6,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "#f8fafc",
    high = tier_colors[["Power"]],
    labels = scales::percent,
    name = "Draft rate"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "white", `FALSE` = "#111827"), guide = "none") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) sub(" ", "\n", x), position = "top") +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    title = "The SEC tops eight of nine positions; the Big Ten tops tight end",
    subtitle = "Outlined: the top conference at each position; conferences ordered by overall draft rate"
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "right", panel.grid = element_blank())
```

```{.r .cell-code}
pos_season <- rates(group_by(fbs_pos, position_group, tier_label, season))
p <- ggplot(
  pos_season,
  aes(season, draft_rate, color = tier_label, group = tier_label)
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(
      tooltip = paste0(
        position_group,
        ", ",
        tier_label,
        ", ",
        season,
        ": ",
        drafted,
        " drafted of ",
        eligible,
        " eligible (",
        pct(draft_rate),
        ")"
      ),
      data_id = paste(position_group, tier_label, season)
    ),
    size = 2.2
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~position_group, ncol = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = tier_colors, name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(2013, 2019, 2025)) +
  labs(
    x = "Final college season",
    y = "Draft rate",
    title = "Draft rate by position, tier, and season",
    subtitle = "Hover a point for counts"
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl(base_size = 14)
girafe(ggobj = p, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 10)
```

```{.r .cell-code}
pos_rate <- rates(group_by(fbs_pos, position_group)) |>
  select(position_group, pos_rate = draft_rate)
# the same benchmark within each tier, applied to each final season's tier
pos_tier_rate <- rates(group_by(fbs_pos, position_group, tier_label)) |>
  select(position_group, tier_label, tier_pos_rate = draft_rate)
school_pos <- fbs_pos |>
  left_join(pos_tier_rate, by = c("position_group", "tier_label")) |>
  group_by(team, position_group) |>
  summarise(
    eligible = sum(n_eligible),
    drafted = sum(n_drafted),
    expected_tier = sum(n_eligible * tier_pos_rate),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  left_join(pos_rate, by = "position_group") |>
  mutate(expected = eligible * pos_rate, above = drafted - expected)
school <- school_pos |>
  group_by(team) |>
  summarise(
    eligible = sum(eligible),
    drafted = sum(drafted),
    expected = sum(expected),
    expected_tier = sum(expected_tier),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    above = drafted - expected,
    above_tier = drafted - expected_tier,
    draft_rate = drafted / eligible
  ) |>
  left_join(fbs_schools, by = "team") |>
  left_join(school_tier, by = "team") |>
  mutate(adjusted = shrink_rate(drafted, eligible, group = conf_now)) |>
  arrange(desc(above))
non_st <- filter(pos_rate, position_group != "Special teams")
st_rate <- pos_rate$pos_rate[pos_rate$position_group == "Special teams"]

  arrange(avg)
```

### 3.4 Alabama produced 92 more draftees than an average FBS school with as many eligible players at the same positions, and Boise State led the Group of 5 against its own tier's rates

Out of every 100 eligible Alabama players, 41
were drafted, 92 more draftees than the
23.5 an average FBS school would have produced with
the same players by position, an adjustment that matters little because
position draft rates range only from 7.7% to
10.1% (special teams 2.2%). Of the
72 Group of 5 schools only Cincinnati, now in the Big 12,
beat that FBS-wide mark, but against Group of 5 rates 24
did, led by Boise State with 21 drafted against
6.9 expected.

```{.r .cell-code}
rank_bars <- bind_rows(
  slice_head(school, n = 15) |>
    mutate(panel = "Top 15 FBS schools, above the FBS average", value = above),
  g5 |>
    arrange(desc(above_tier)) |>
    slice_head(n = 15) |>
    mutate(panel = "Top 15 Group of 5 schools, above the Group of 5 average", value = above_tier)
) |>
  mutate(
    key = paste(panel, team, sep = "___"),
    highlight = if_else(team %in% c("Alabama", g5_best$team), team, "Other")
  )
p <- ggplot(rank_bars, aes(value, reorder(key, value), fill = highlight)) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(
      tooltip = paste0(
        team,
        ": ",
        drafted,
        " drafted of ",
        eligible,
        " eligible; ",
        fmt(drafted - value, 1),
        " expected, ",
        fmt(value, 1),
        " above"
      ),
      data_id = paste(panel, team)
    ),
    width = 0.75
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = filter(rank_bars, highlight != "Other"),
    aes(label = paste0("+", fmt(value)), color = highlight),
    hjust = -0.15,
    size = 5,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~panel, scales = "free", ncol = 2) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) sub(".*___", "", x)) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.18))) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Alabama" = bama_color,
      setNames(boise_color, g5_best$team),
      "Other" = "#9ca3af"
    ),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Alabama" = bama_color, setNames(boise_color, g5_best$team)),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Draftees above expected",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Alabama leads FBS, and Boise State leads the Group of 5 against its own tier",
    subtitle = "Expected: an average school (FBS-wide, or same tier) with the same eligible players by position"
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl(base_size = 14)
girafe(ggobj = p, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 9)
```

The dot chart groups schools by their 2025 conference, used only here.
Because a school with few eligible players can post a high or low rate by
luck, each rate is pulled toward the conference average, more strongly the
fewer players behind it (a method called empirical Bayes shrinkage), which
moves Idaho, with 16 eligible players and
none drafted, from 0.0% to 1.9%.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
dots <- school |>
  mutate(
    conf_now = factor(conf_now, levels = conf_avg$conf_now),
    is_leader = team %in% conf_leader$team,
    tip = paste0(
      team,
      " (2025: ",
      conf_now,
      ")\n",
      drafted,
      " drafted of ",
      eligible,
      " eligible; adjusted rate ",
      pct(adjusted),
      "\nExpected ",
      fmt(expected, 1),
      " at the FBS average (",
      if_else(above >= 0, "+", ""),
      fmt(above, 1),
      "), ",
      fmt(expected_tier, 1),
      " at its tier's (",
      if_else(above_tier >= 0, "+", ""),
      fmt(above_tier, 1),
      ")"
    )
  )
lead_dots <- filter(dots, is_leader)
p <- ggplot(dots, aes(adjusted, conf_now)) +
  geom_point(
    data = mutate(conf_avg, conf_now = factor(conf_now, levels = conf_avg$conf_now)),
    aes(avg, conf_now),
    shape = 124,
    size = 12,
    color = "#111827"
  ) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    data = filter(dots, !is_leader),
    aes(tooltip = tip, data_id = team),
    size = 3.6,
    color = "#9ca3af",
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    data = lead_dots,
    aes(fill = team, tooltip = tip, data_id = team),
    shape = 21,
    size = 6,
    color = "#111827",
    stroke = 1
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = lead_dots,
    aes(label = team, color = team),
    hjust = 0,
    nudge_x = 0.008,
    size = 4.8,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = team_colors, guide = "none") +
  scale_color_manual(values = team_colors, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 0.47)) +
  labs(
    x = "Adjusted draft rate",
    y = "2025 conference",
    title = "Every FBS school against its 2025 conference's average",
    subtitle = "Black tick: conference average; colored dot: the conference leader; hover a dot for both expectations"
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl()
girafe(ggobj = p, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 8)
```

```{.r .cell-code}
  left_join(

    by = c("claimant", "position_group")
  ) |>
  left_join(
    select(pos_top, position_group, leader = team, leader_drafted = drafted, leader_above = above),
```

### 3.5 Alabama leads four positions, and three of six fan nicknames hold up as top-five schools, with only LSU's WRU first

Ranked by draftees above expected, LSU is first at receiver and
5th at defensive back, and Iowa is
5th at tight end behind Notre Dame, so DBU and
Tight End U are close rather than misses. Penn State ranks
22nd at linebacker (defensive ends and edge
rushers count in the defensive line, where it ranks 7th with
15 drafted), while USC (22nd at
running back) and BYU (36th at quarterback, an
independent until 2023) rest on small samples of
12 and 14 eligible
players.

```{.r .cell-code}
    key = paste(position_group, label, sep = "___")

  bars,
  aes(above, reorder(key, above), fill = if_else(is_claim, team, "Other"))

  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(
      tooltip = paste0(
        team,
        ", ",
        tolower(position_group),
        ": ",
        drafted,
        " drafted of ",
        eligible,
        " eligible, ",
        fmt(above, 1),
        " above expected (rank ",
        rank,
        ")",
        if_else(is_claim, paste0("\nClaims the nickname ", nickname), "")
      ),
      data_id = paste(team, position_group)
    ),
    width = 0.75
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~position_group, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) sub(".*___", "", x)) +
  scale_fill_manual(

  labs(
    x = "Draftees above expected",

  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl(base_size = 13)
```

```{.r .cell-code}
grid_df <- school_pos |>
  mutate(team = factor(team, levels = rev(school$team)))
lim <- max(abs(grid_df$above))
p <- ggplot(grid_df, aes(position_group, team, fill = above)) +
  geom_tile_interactive(
    aes(
      tooltip = paste0(
        team,
        ", ",
        tolower(position_group),
        "\n",
        drafted,
        " drafted of ",
        eligible,
        " eligible; ",
        fmt(expected, 1),
        " expected\n",
        fmt(above, 1),
        " above expected (rank ",
        rank,
        " of ",
        n_schools,
        ")"
      ),
      data_id = paste(team, position_group)
    ),
    color = "white"
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#b45309",
    mid = "#f8fafc",
    high = tier_colors[["Power"]],
    midpoint = 0,
    limits = c(-lim, lim),
    name = "Above\nexpected"
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) sub(" ", "\n", x), position = "top") +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    title = "Every FBS school at every position",
    subtitle = "Draftees above (blue) or below (orange) expected; schools ordered by total above expected; hover a tile for counts"
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl(base_size = 10) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), legend.position = "right")
girafe(ggobj = p, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 26)
```

## 5. Discussion


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# Draftees credited to a Power school who had earlier played at a Group of
# 5 school, by draft class: the transfer route up.
reused <- reused_ids(roster)
tiered_roster <- roster |>
  distinct(playerId, season, team) |>
  left_join(
    select(team_season, team, season, tier_label),
    by = c("team", "season")
  )
class_picks <- picks |>
  filter(
    !is.na(playerId),
    !playerId %in% reused,
    year >= first_season + 1L,
    year <= last_season + 1L
  ) |>
  group_by(playerId) |>
  slice_max(year, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(playerId, year)
moved_up <- tiered_roster |>
  inner_join(class_picks, by = "playerId") |>
  filter(season < year) |>
  arrange(playerId, season) |>
  group_by(playerId, year) |>
  summarise(
    last_tier = last(tier_label),
    ever_g5 = any(tier_label == "Group of 5", na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(last_tier == "Power") |>
  count(year, wt = ever_g5, name = "from_g5")
early_max <- max(moved_up$from_g5[moved_up$year <= 2022L])
up_2026 <- moved_up$from_g5[moved_up$year == 2026L]
ol_udfa <- rates(filter(fbs_pos, position_group == "Offensive line"))
other_udfa <- rates(
  filter(fbs_pos, !position_group %in% c("Offensive line", "Special teams"))
)
```
:::


::: {.callout-important}
Draft production is concentrated inside the Power conferences, not just
between tiers.

- Alabama, Ohio State, LSU and Georgia each produced at least 65 more
  draftees than an average FBS school with the same players by position.
- At 5 of the six nickname positions another
  school leads, Alabama at
  4 of them.
:::

::: {.callout-important}
The Group of 5 draft rate fell while more draftees credited to Power
schools had earlier played at Group of 5 schools.

- Those draftees numbered at most 12 per class through 2022 and
  40 in the class of 2026. Each counts for the Power school they
  finished at, not the Group of 5 school they left.
:::

::: {.callout-important}
For Group of 5 players, undrafted signings are the broader route to the
NFL.

- Every Group of 5 conference sent more players to NFL rosters undrafted
  than through the draft.
:::

Each draftee is credited to the last college roster before the draft,
eligibility is a roster-based stand-in for a real shot at the NFL, and
final seasons 2013 to 2025 only approximately match the classes of 2014 to
2026. Undrafted offensive linemen are undercounted (an undrafted rate of
1.8%, against 9.9% at the
other non-kicking positions) because the NFL match runs through college
stat lines. FCS-and-below rosters are incomplete, so that tier enters only
as one total.
